Definition: a revolution, i.e. (of the sun) course, (of time) lapse
BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, tᵉqûwphâh means the course of the sun, the turn of the year. In Exodus 34:22, the feast of ingathering at the year's end, and it appears again in 1 Samuel 1:20.
TheologicalSignificance: The turn of the year bringing Hannah her child reminds me that God keeps His own calendar, and His timing is never late.
